title: Euphrasy
summary: EU'PHRASY, noun [According to DeTheis, this word is contracted from euphrosyne, joy, pleasure; a name given to the plant on account of its wonderful effects in curing disorders of the eyes.] Eyebright

inlines.v: EU'PHRASY, noun [According to DeTheis, this word is contracted from euphrosyne, joy, pleasure; a name given to the plant on account of its wonderful effects in curing disorders of the eyes.] Eyebright, a genus of plants, Euphrasia, called in French casse-lunette.
